title: No loading state on the Lists pages
where: /admin/lists and /admin/lists/<id>, any width, while the server loads
what_happens: From code, not seen: neither route has a loading.tsx or Suspense fallback (only the session page has a skeleton, SessionBodySkeleton). Clicking a list keeps the old page with no sign anything is happening until the server answers. Not visible in a screenshot on a fast connection.
who_hurts: An admin on a slow connection who clicks a list and may click again.
suggested_fix: Add src/app/admin/lists/loading.tsx and lists/[id]/loading.tsx with a small skeleton, reusing the style of SessionBodySkeleton in src/app/admin/sessions/[code]/page.tsx.
